about: V3-33 (product.yaml#decisions.D77_v3 (14б)): providers a user may connect an own key to. acceptsRu=true — the provider takes requests from our servers in RF, called directly at baseUrl; acceptsRu=false — only through the user's own OpenAI-compatible gateway (officialHosts are never called directly). verifiedModels — checked by us in the pipeline; any other model is marked «не проверена нами». A change of this list is a PR with the source of the provider's terms.

providers.name: Z.ai (GLM)
providers.termsNote: the platform calls Z.ai from RF on its own key (models.yaml#providers.zai, termsCheckedAt 2026-09-30)

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.termsNote: the eval challenger of the platform is called from RF (models.yaml#providers.deepseek, termsCheckedAt 2026-10-01); storage in China

providers.name: Moonshot (Kimi)
providers.termsNote: models.yaml#providers.moonshot (termsCheckedAt 2026-09-30); the API trains on content — the user decides under the consent

providers.name: Cloud.ru Foundation Models
providers.termsNote: partner models of the catalog are served outside RF — scrub applies to every BYOK call anyway

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.termsNote: blocks access from unsupported countries; RF is not supported

providers.name: Anthropic (Claude)
providers.termsNote: RF is not in the supported countries

providers.name: Google (Gemini)
providers.termsNote: RF is not in the available regions

providers.name: Другой провайдер через ваш шлюз
providers.termsNote: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint of the user (proxy, corporate Azure, OpenRouter, LiteLLM)
